failure_policy: Record all attempts; no cap expansion for individual formal items. Retry once for transient error or invalid gate JSON. Length truncation is a recorded failure without retry. Failed arms have no fabricated score; report completion and analyze available pairs plus failure counts.
gate_output_format: JSON schema constrained decoding for existing frozen prompt fields and types, with maxItems matching the original gate normalization limits
evidence_level: Frozen configuration and formal local request records; later Gemini judge amendment supersedes original protocol judge field
generation_metadata: Identical question, stage and formatting metadata for both conditions; no D1-D10 labels, reference answers or external tools
